title: ABLATION: producers without seeded decomposers or heterotroph income must fail?

identity.note: The probe always ran from the current checkout. A historical arm spec applied here is a settings replay, not a reproduction of its original figure.

preregistration.hypothesis: The viability config (prod 13/18, cons 11/18) couples producers to decomposer recycling. With no seeded decomposers (founders slot 0) and heterotroph income impossible (graze explicitly 0, meat preset 0), producers should fail: the abiotic floor alone must not carry them.
preregistration.prediction: prod == 0 on at least 30/36 seeds at tick 6000 (machine criterion). Coexistence NOT predicted; nothing about consumers or decomposers is predicted.
preregistration.falsification: FALSIFIED (reliance not obligate as configured) if prod > 0 on 7 or more of 36 seeds. Two honest sub-cases, both reported descriptively: (a) producers persist with NO decomposers ever present — the abiotic floor or initial stock carries them, and the reliance clause fails cleanly; (b) decomposer roles re-emerge via fluidity and producers persist with them — reliance on the FUNCTION holds but seeding-independence fails, and the clause needs restating, not re-running.
preregistration.notPredicted: Consumer transients (founded consumers starve on initial detritus; momentary presence is expected, not a finding), decomposer re-emergence counts (descriptive), B/D trajectories (descriptive), bloom sizes.
confoundsControlled: Same horizon, engine, and 15-slot argvRest as graze-viability (rsur 30 kept); differences stated, not hidden: founders slot 0.25 -> 0 AND graze lift 1.0 -> 0 (heterotroph income impossible)

Abiotic floor 0.05 retained deliberately: it is not a guild, so keeping it tests guild reliance specifically — if the floor alone carries producers, that is sub-case (a), a clean falsification, not a confound
Dormancy/spore support retained (support is not seeding); disease, sat, cyc, regen identical to base
36 seeds span both established panels (41001-41018, 52001-52018); no new seeds, no prospective claim
conservation enforced per seed at 0.5%; a seed above it fails the run rather than reporting

criteria.statement: producers = 0 at tick 6000 on at least 30/36 seeds
